title: Git Flow

setup.label: Set up Git Flow
setup.sameBranch: The main and development branches must be different.
setup.prefixDuplicate: The three prefixes must differ – otherwise no one can tell what a branch is.
setup.developMissing: The development branch needs a name.
setup.mainHint: Finished releases and hotfixes end up here.
setup.developExists: This branch already exists – it will be used.
setup.example: With these, a feature “map” is called {{feature}}map, and the tag of a release “1.2.0” is {{tag}}1.2.0.

start.title: Start
start.notReady: Set up Git Flow first – without a main and a development branch there is nothing a branch could start from.
start.operation: Finish the operation in progress (merge, rebase …) first.
start.running: The {{kind}} “{{name}}” ({{branch}}) is already in progress. Finish it first.
start.locked: Locked: Git Flow isn't set up in this repository yet. Choose the main and development branches above.
start.name: Name
start.featureHint: For a new feature. Several features can run side by side.
start.releaseHint: Freezes the state for a version. Only one release at a time.
start.hotfixHint: For an urgent fix to the released state. Only one hotfix at a time.

description.setup: Git Flow organizes work into fixed branches: one for released states, one for development, plus features, releases and hotfixes.
description.ready: Start and finish features, releases or hotfixes – with ordinary Git branches, no extra program needed.

readFailed: The Git Flow state couldn't be read

notSetUp.title: Git Flow isn't set up here yet
notSetUp.body: Define which branch is which. Only the usual gitflow entries are written to .git/config – an existing “git flow” understands them too.

active.title: In progress ({{count}})
active.empty: No feature, release or hotfix in progress.
active.label: Active Git Flow branches

finish.conflicts: Resolve the open conflicts and finish the merge first.
finish.changes_one: The working directory has {{count}} uncommitted change. Commit or stash it first.
finish.changes_other: The working directory has {{count}} uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them first.
finish.title: Finish {{kind}} “{{name}}”?
finish.taggedDescription: <branch>{{branch}}</branch> is merged into <main>{{main}}</main>, marked there as a version, and merged back into <develop>{{develop}}</develop>. Afterwards {{develop}} is checked out.
finish.featureDescription: <branch>{{branch}}</branch> is merged into <develop>{{develop}}</develop> with a merge commit. Afterwards {{develop}} is checked out.
finish.deleteBranchHint: {{branch}} is removed locally; its commits are kept through the merge.
finish.tagHint: Annotated tag on the merge commit in {{main}}.
finish.undoNote: Right afterwards, “Undo” reverts the whole finish – as long as nothing has been pushed.
